rule: One clearing record per ARN (23 digits)
on_failure: Reject the duplicate to the acquirer

rule: Acquirer and merchant identifiers exist in the member referential
MCC exists in the MCC referential
Card number is a token: no clear PAN in any field (Luhn-valid 16-digit strings are searched)
on_failure: Reject the file and alert security

rule: Amount is a positive integer in minor units
Currency and country codes translate with T-01
Transaction date is at most 30 days before the clearing date and not in the future
Transaction type and entry mode translate with T-02 and T-03
ECI is present when entry mode is ECOM
Each purchase matches one authorisation (token + auth code + amount within the tolerance)
